verdict.rationale: Carta's API platform does expose read endpoints for cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, and 409A valuations (carta-docs-18–23) which could technically be used to pull data out, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' or account-closure data-portability feature. Concrete hands-on community reports directly contradict the 'leave easily with your data' framing: founders describe Carta deliberately obstructing cancellation and cap-table transfer to competitors (carta-comm-4, carta-comm-5, carta-comm-7). Missing for 10: an explicit open-format full data export/account closure workflow, and resolution of the documented obstruction to leaving.
